scripts.build: npm run build:contract && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contract && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @playsync/contract && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.load:smoke: docker compose -f backend/docker-compose.test.yml --profile load --profile k6 run --rm k6 run --out json=/load/results/smoke-raw.json -e LOAD_THINK_FAST_MS=0 -e LOAD_THINK_SLOW_MS=0 -e LOAD_DEAL_MS=0 /load/scenarios/smoke.js
scripts.load:ramp-b: docker compose -f backend/docker-compose.test.yml --profile load --profile k6 run --rm k6 run --out json=/load/results/ramp-b-raw.json -e LOAD_RECONNECT_AT_TABLES=30 /load/scenarios/ramp.js
scripts.load:ramp-a: docker compose -f backend/docker-compose.test.yml --profile load --profile k6 run --rm k6 run --out json=/load/results/ramp-a-raw.json -e LOAD_TABLES_PER_STORE=6 -e LOAD_RECONNECT_AT_TABLES=30 /load/scenarios/ramp.js
scripts.load:down: docker compose -f backend/docker-compose.test.yml --profile load --profile k6 down -v
